subject: Annual prepay collection cadence and VAT routing — proposed standup action items
messages:
From: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@brightlane.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Brightlane Finance <acct-ops@brightlane.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Annual prepay proposal & ask on VAT routing

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Brightlane is excited about Redwood's performance profile. Our finance team put together a short proposal for an annual committed prepay to simplify forecasting and reduce unit rates. High level: 600,000 USD annual commitment, drawn down monthly in 12 equal tranches (50,000 USD/month).

Two asks before we lock the SOW:
- How does Redwood prefer to invoice for that cadence (monthly invoice in advance vs invoice at drawdown)?
- We operate two legal entities (Brightlane US and Brightlane EU). Can you confirm VAT handling if we route payment from the EU entity? We'll attach VAT IDs and bank remit details after we lock cadence.

I've attached the proposal workbook (Brightlane_Annual_Prepay_Proposal.xlsx) with suggested milestone dates and a sample remit sheet. Can we schedule a 30-minute operational standup next week to finalize invoicing and banking?

Thanks,
Sarah Lewis
Finance Manager — Brightlane
attachments: Brightlane_Annual_Prepay_Proposal.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@brightlane.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay proposal & ask on VAT routing

Hi Sarah — thanks for sending this over and for the clear workbook. KD for internal ops/questions below and happy to join a 30-min call next week.

Short answers up front:
- Redwood's default is to invoice monthly in advance and apply the prepay credit to usage consumption; however we can do invoice-at-drawdown if your AP team prefers.
- For EU-originated payments we need VAT ID + entity mapping so we emit the correct VAT treatment on the invoice and route settlement through our EU billing entity. If Brightlane will remit from the EU entity, please provide the VAT ID and the legal entity name — we'll map in our ledger.

Internal: Kimberly / Jonas / Logan — can you review the attached draft SOW and the proposed monthly-in-advance invoice flow and surface any ops blockers before our call? I've attached a draft Redwood scope doc to start (Redwood_Draft_SOW_v1.docx).

Proposed next steps:
1) Ops sync (30m) — confirm invoice timing, VAT entity mapping, remit accounts, and PO/PO number expectations.
2) Redwood sends final SOW + invoice template.
3) Brightlane returns signed SOW and remit + VAT evidence.

Available windows next week: Thu 09/23 10:00-11:00 PT or Fri 09/24 13:00-14:00 PT. Which works?

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_Draft_SOW_v1.docx (docx)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay proposal & ask on VAT routing

Tessa / team — quick ops notes after a first-pass on Brightlane's workbook: 

Actionable items for the standup (my recommended defaults in parentheses):
- Invoice cadence: monthly in advance (1st of month) — easier for cash reconciliation and aligns with our prepay credit allocation.
- Ledger & tagging: tag prepay as 'commitment:BR-2026-0567' and emit monthly invoice referencing the commitment id. Jonas, can you add a ledger rule?
- VAT handling: If Brightlane EU remits, we need
  * EU VAT ID (company legal name + VAT ID)
  * billing contact for reverse-charge confirmation (if applicable)
- PO/terms: prefer net-30 from invoice date. If they need net-45/60, escalate to commercial for a term exception.
- Remit instructions: provide both USD bank and SEPA (if EU entity will settle). We should include intermediary bank notes for SEPA to USD conversions.

I've annotated the draft SOW with invoice samples and a sample invoice footer capturing the VAT fields. I'll bring the annotated doc to the call.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay proposal & ask on VAT routing

Kim — I'm on boarding for ledger rules and agree with the 1st-of-month advance invoice approach. Quick notes: 
- I'll add the ledger tag 'commitment:BR-2026-0567' and a secondary tag for "prepay-bucket:annual" so reporting can slice by commitment type.
- For EU VAT: we need either the VAT ID for the legal entity or a signed reverse-charge declaration. If they provide a VAT ID for the EU entity, our billing system will suppress VAT on the invoice and record the EU entity in the billing entity field.
- I'll prepare two sample invoice PDFs for the call: (1) monthly advance USD invoice and (2) monthly advance SEPA/GBP example showing intermediary bank notes.

I'll be on the standup 09/23 10:00 PT.

-jw
Jonas Weber
Finance Systems Lead — Redwood Inference

- Remitting contact: Sarah Lewis (acct-ops@brightlane.com) / +44 20 5555 0123.
- PO#: BL-2026-9087 (please put on all monthly invoices).

Attachments: remit_instructions_SEPA.pdf (payment instruction stub), Brightlane_VAT_evidence.pdf (VAT ID screenshot).

Happy to have the 09/23 standup — same time 10:00 PT.

Thanks,
Sarah Lewis
